description: Apple privacy manifest for the app's own code: the data the app itself collects (ownData ids), its own tracking (with tracking domains), the required-reason APIs its code uses with Apple's reason codes, and optionally SDKs linked statically without their own manifest. SDKs with their own manifest are covered by theirs (Apple). Categories: NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp (DDA9.1, C617.1, 3B52.1); NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategorySystemBootTime (35F9.1, 8FFB.1, 3D61.1); NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace (85F4.1, E174.1, 7D9E.1, B728.1); NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryActiveKeyboards (3EC4.1, 54BD.1); NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults (CA92.1, 1C8F.1, AC6B.1). Returns plist (XML), manifest (the same as JSON) and problems (empty when App Store Connect should accept it).
name: generate_privacy_manifest
title: Generate the app's PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
